span.label: the motivation for dropout - AN ANALOGY, FLAGGED AS ONE: a theory of the role of sex in evolution, in which combining half of each parent's genes beats copying a good genome directly; the paper presents this as a motivation and not as a derivation, and its only proof of an equivalent regularizer is for linear regression
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the test-time network - A STAND-IN FOR AN ENSEMBLE THAT IS NEVER BUILT: a single unthinned network with scaled weights approximates an equally weighted geometric mean over an exponential number of thinned networks, so the rule everyone implements is a cheap approximation to a computation nobody performs
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a thinned network - ONE SAMPLE FROM 2^n: applying dropout amounts to sampling a thinned network, and a net with n units is described as a collection of that many possible thinned networks all sharing weights, so 'a dropout network' names a distribution over architectures rather than one architecture
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
